metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code: my-react (React/TS spec-driven flow + driver agents), my-flutter (Flutter/Dart rules + skills), think (clarify / explore / architect), my-invest (cited value-investing stock research). Profiles install independently.

plugins.name: my-react
plugins.description: React/TS spec-driven workflow: driver-embedded phase process, contract skills, atlas auditor, driver + worker agents.

plugins.name: my-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter/Dart spec-driven skills: AC authoring, architecture design (P1–P8), Riverpod, test quality, PR review.

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Stack-neutral skillset for working with agents efficiently, for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: clarify (ambiguity → decision + brief), explore (codebase), architect (design / discuss / evaluate, level-aware); light preferences file; explorer + scout agents; no-CLI installer.

plugins.name: my-invest
plugins.description: Value-investing research for US stocks from plain questions: analyze (price outlook at 1/2/5/10 years, buy and sell zones with timing, reasons, strengths and weaknesses, options context, holdings and Canadian tax treatment, short-term lens, charts, growing dossiers), find (ranked screen for a horizon and strategy), digest (daily or weekly); lint-enforced citations.
